rationale: Nitrogen limitation (ammonium + arginine-derived N ~2.5 mmol/gDW/h) restricts growth to ~0.25 /h. Glucose, lactate, and arabinose ferment to acetate, propionate, and succinate via mixed-acid pathways. Arginine provides both C and N. Carbon balance verified: 111 mmol C in − 10.5 (biomass) − 48.5 (products) leaves margin for additional CO₂.
